title: BINGO
tagline: BINGO is a decentalized elivery platform for ecommerce or social markets that allows for smooth end to end delivery flow and dispute resolution
description:
There have been issues with delivery and logistics as this is the bedrock of any online transaction either grass root or international, but the process has not been a smooth one as people often get a substandard product or a product.

Bingo is a solution that aims to bring transparency into the market buy using UMA and giving out rewards in form of tokens.
